ロックマンは、2%で先手を買い続ける

Mega Man does not need a giant combo to make a match feel one-sided. His 2% pellets can force the opponent to jump, shield, stop or rush before they wanted to. That reaction creates the next question: Metal Blade, Crash Bomber, grab or aerial pressure. At kill percent, the plan does not become random smash attacks. The same initiative is cashed out through frame-4 Bair, frame-6 Mega Upper, Fair at the ledge or Uair above. The point is not projectile spam. It is control over who has to answer first.
